verdict.rationale: Galileo is an LLM tracing and observability platform, so capturing multimodal payloads in traces is a fair question for it. The evidence pack only documents generic session, trace and span capture, OTel distributed tracing and the @log decorator. None of it mentions logging images, audio or files inside traces.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
